answer: Latency multilateration curbs Sybil attacks by bounding agent response times to physical speed-of-light round trips. Nodes decrypt challenges using an authenticated cipher and reply to regional beacons, such as edge nodes at a coastal wharf. An attacker incurs the verifiable cost of deploying geographically distributed physical hardware instead of running virtual clones in an onyx server rack. A key limitation is that routing jitter can falsely disqualify honest agents.
